profiles.Boogie Blind:
Boogie Blind is a pioneering turntablist and DJ known for his deep roots in hip hop and vinyl culture, particularly in the New York City scene. He is a central figure in the underground hip hop and DJ culture movement, blending turntablism with live performance and radio broadcasting. His work is closely tied to the NYC hip hop scene, especially through collaborations with artists like Lord Finesse, The Pharcyde, and Dilla. He is recognized for his technical mastery and influence in the DJ battle and vinyl culture scenes.
Performs as: Boogie Blind, X-Ecutioners, DJ Boogie Blind (X-Ecutioners), Boogie Blind (X-Men), DJ Fatfingaz, DJ Eclipse
Their channels, stations, shows, clubs, labels, collaborators: Boiler Room NYC; Turntable Lab; The Listening Xperience; The OldSkool Collective; Carhartt WIP Radio Tour; BIG CROWN RECORDS (BCR Radio); Lord Finesse; The Pharcyde; X FACTOR BOOGIE BLIND; Road Podcast (Reflections Of A DJ); Fresh 45s (May 2015); Pharcyde TV Sounds; Frank Friction; JahWise777 BLACK WAXX INT’L; Across 135th Street; Definitive DITC; The Boogie Blind Residence

profiles.Diamond D:
Diamond D is a hip-hop producer and DJ, not an electronic music artist. He is best known for his work in the hip-hop scene, particularly associated with the D.I.T.C. (Downtown Irving Tenth Community) collective. His recordings are rooted in hip-hop culture, featuring collaborations with artists like Large Professor, Talib Kweli, and DJ Premier. He is active in New York City and has performed in cities such as San Diego, Manchester, Dubai, and San Francisco.
Performs as: Diamond D, D.I.T.C., Diamond D (D.I.T.C.)

profiles.Guy Contact:
Guy Contact is a British electronic music producer and DJ known for his deep house and soulful house sound, active primarily in the UK and international scenes. He is associated with the Berlin and Melbourne electronic music scenes, and frequently performs at major festivals and radio shows. His work spans live sets, radio mixes, and collaborations with artists across the global underground electronic circuit. He is a prominent figure in the deep house and progressive house communities, especially in Europe and Australia.
Performs as: Guy Contact
Their channels, stations, shows, clubs, labels, collaborators: HÖR BERLIN; Boiler Room; M•D (Essential Mix); Skylab Radio (Live From Music Room); System X ONO; Refuge Worldwide (Berlin); Seoul Community Radio (Perth); Butter Sessions; Neurocrank Mix; Melbourne Deepcast; Dimensions Festival; Pitch Music & Arts; Sonar Festival; Supercamp Festival; Rinse France; Pjenne (PN 129); Origins Tapes; Haŵs; Oddysee; Beats of No Nation; Aaja Music; Torture the Artist; Bethany (Glamorama)

profiles.Raresh:
Raresh is a Romanian electronic music producer and DJ known for his work in minimal house, techno, and ambient genres. Active since the early 2000s, he is deeply rooted in the Romanian underground scene, frequently performing at key clubs like Zebra Club, Sunwaves, and The Bandwagon. His collaborations with figures like Petre Inspirescu, Rhadoo, and Arapu link him to the broader European minimal house and techno networks, especially in Romania, Bulgaria, and Spain. He has also performed internationally at festivals and events in Chile, Switzerland, and the US.
Performs as: Raresh, RareshEN, Praslesh (with Praslea), Raresh Rush, RARESH
Their channels, stations, shows, clubs, labels, collaborators: Zebra Club (Bucharest); Sunwaves (Mamaia, Romania); The Bandwagon (Brooklyn, NY); Cubecast Radio; DC10 Ibiza; Secret Solstice (Romania); Raresh Rush (guest mixes); Petre Inspirescu; Rhadoo; Arapu; Praslea; Minimal House Underground; Sunrise Bucharest; Fabric 78; Tales From The Loop; Only Music Matters; DTech Minimal; HouseOnWheels; Houghton (UK); Monteoru (Romania); Cocoon (Ibiza); Sunrise Hub

profiles.[a:rpia:r]:
Arpiar is a Romanian electronic music producer and DJ known for his work in deep house, minimal techno, and ruminant electronic scenes. He is a central figure in the Romanian underground, frequently collaborating with Rhadoo, Raresh, and Petre Inspirescu, and has performed extensively across Europe, especially in Romania, Ibiza, Mexico City, and Chile. His music is closely tied to the Circoloco DC10 festival and the Sunwaves Festival circuit, reflecting a deep connection to the Balkan and Mediterranean electronic scenes.
Performs as: [a:rpia:r], a:rpia:r, arpiar, [arpiar], A:RPIA:R, Arpiar, RPR Soundsystem
